feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 August 2026 10:01pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 01 August 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure over the Norwegian Sea and near the Azores. High pressure to the southeast of Greenland, with a ridge to Brittany.


##Wind##

Mainly west or southwest 3 or 4 at first tonight, becoming variable 3 or less later in the night & Sunday morning. Settling mainly east or northeast 2 to 4 during the afternoon, becoming mainly northeast 3 or 4, occasional 5, later in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy rain spreading from the west later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, then occasionally moderate in places later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6 overnight & at first on Monday, decreasing 3 or 4 in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, soon becoming slight or moderate for a while.


##Weather##

Occasional rain spreading from the west.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
